item.title: The Character-Indexed Object Problem in Laravel Docker APIs
item.description: This is a character-indexed object issue encountered in a Laravel + Docker + Nginx deployment environment, where the API, instead of returning a valid JSON object, occasionally responds with an object whose keys are string indices and whose values are the individual characters of the intended JSON string.
